description: This file defines logic to resolve the effective connection mode in an application based on various configuration sources such as a provided root dictionary, stored user defaults, and onboarding state. It includes enumerations for sources and connection modes, and a resolver function that determines the current mode and its source.

classes.name: EffectiveConnectionMode
classes.description: A struct representing the current connection mode along with its source of origin.

classes.name: EffectiveConnectionModeSource
classes.description: An enumeration listing possible sources for the effective connection mode.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Statically determines the current effective connection mode based on input root dictionary, defaults, and stored onboarding state.
